title: Data analyst interview in Dubai, interviewer with Arabic-accented English

brief.title: Data Analyst at Sahra Freight
brief.goals: Show the delivery-time dashboards; ask what data the team works with
brief.done: Applied through LinkedIn; HR call done
brief.to_discuss: Salary in dirhams, visa sponsorship, notice period
brief.instructions: Speak slowly and simply. I have not used SAP.

documents.title: CV
documents.text:
Usman Tariq. Data analyst, 4 years. SQL, Python (pandas), Power BI, Excel.
2021-2025 Barq Couriers, Karachi: built delivery-time dashboards in Power BI used by 12 city managers; late deliveries fell by 18% in one year.
BS Statistics, University of Karachi, 2020.
Visa: needs employment visa sponsorship. Notice period: one month.

events.text: Good morning, Mr Khalid. Thank you for your time.
Good morning Usman, welcome. So first, you can tell me please, what is the salary you are expecting? In dirham.
events.reference:
I would like to hear the range for this role first.
- **Open**: flexible for the right team
Say next: What range do you have for this position?

events.text: Okay. Tell me, what you did exactly in Barq Couriers with the dashboards?
events.reference:
I built delivery-time dashboards in Power BI.
- **Users**: 12 city managers
- **Result**: late deliveries fell by 18% in one year

events.text: I built Power BI dashboards for 12 city managers. Late deliveries fell 18 percent in one year.
Very good. And SAP, you know SAP? Our warehouse is all on SAP.
events.reference:
Not SAP itself, but I work with data from systems like it.
- **SQL**: I can query the warehouse data
- **Power BI**: I can build the reports on top

bad.answer: Yes, I worked with SAP at Barq Couriers for the warehouse reports.

events.text: Not SAP directly. I work with SQL and exports.
Okay, I will write here: no SAP, but strong in SQL.

bad.answer: Thank you, I can learn SAP very fast.

events.text: Inshallah we decide about the candidates by the end of this month.
How you check the data is correct before you send a report to the managers?
events.reference:
I check it against the source before every report.
- **Totals**: compare with the system totals
- **Spot checks**: open a few records by hand

events.text: I compare totals with the source system and spot check a few records.
Sorry, the line was not clear before. How much the late deliveries went down?
events.reference:
By 18% in one year.
- **How**: Power BI dashboards for 12 city managers

events.text: And the salary, you said how much? Sixteen or eighteen?
The visa, you need us to sponsor it?
events.reference:
Yes, I need employment visa sponsorship.
- **Notice**: I can join after one month's notice

events.text: Okay. You have any questions for me?
events.reference:
Yes, one question.
- **Data**: which data sources does the team use most?
Say next: What would my first report be?

bad.answer: When will you make the decision?
